jobs.description:
HERAUSFORDERUNG UND PERSPEKTIVE

Bei uns lernst du Agentic Coding dort, wo es bereits täglich eingesetzt wird!

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences.

jobs.title: Brand Protection Specialist (SEO)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Brand Protection Specialist (SEO) based in United Kingdom.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting a global digital brand and its intellectual property across search engines and online channels.
You will monitor the web for unauthorized content, investigate potential infringements, and coordinate effective enforcement actions.
The role sits at the intersection of SEO, digital brand protection, copyright, and online compliance.
You will work closely with Legal, Marketing, and SEO stakeholders to identify threats and protect branded search visibility.
The position offers a high degree of ownership, requiring strong research skills and the ability to independently resolve complex online cases.
You will collaborate with external platforms and service providers, including domain registrars, hosting companies, and web-security providers.
This fully remote role is well suited to a detail-oriented, proactive professional who enjoys investigative work in a fast-paced international environment.

Working fully remotely within a global team, you’ll have meaningful ownership in a fast-growing technology environment.
